headline: A University of Bern team trained an AI on simulated planetary systems and used it to name 44 known star systems that may hide undiscovered Earth-like planets.
score_reason: Interesting target list, but all accuracy figures come from simulations and no planet is confirmed.
importance_line: Planet hunters could use the list to choose where to point telescopes, though the 99% precision applies only to simulated systems and no predicted planet has been found.
summary: The Brighter Side of News reports on a Bern-led study in Astronomy & Astrophysics in which a machine-learning model, trained on simulated systems and reaching up to 99% precision there, flagged 44 of 1,567 real planetary systems as possible hosts of Earth-like planets. The planets are unconfirmed, and the method depends on a planet-formation simulation that the article says places too many planets close to their stars.
